feature: Unified tuning view (Improvement 1): measurement + target overlays on the EQ composite canvas
applied_via: HTML/JS edit + page reload (bridge already running with all prior patches)

what_was_built.chip: eqOv 'Meas + target' in EQ chips row, default on, persisted localStorage['ds18.eqOv']

layers.measurement: #e6ecf5 solid 2px - live mic (10-frame poll-history average) when fresh, else tapped-or-latest saved capture, else 'no measurement'; pinned at plot edge beyond span
layers.target: #b38cff dashed [6,4] 2px - per-channel LR24 slice (tgtAt + tgtHpDb/tgtLpDb, same math auto-EQ will use); line BREAKS outside +/-span instead of plunging

what_was_built.alignment: eqOvWin() = channel passband [hp||20 .. lp||20000], fallback 200-5000; measurement centered at own passband mean = 0 dB line; target centered on same footing; shape-only (no SPL anchor yet)
what_was_built.freshness: RTA.lastOk timestamp set on poll success; <2s = live, else saved capture
what_was_built.polling: showTab starts rtaPoll for eq tab while overlay on; chip off calls rtaStop; eqOvRefresh redraws composite canvas on each poll while eq tab active
what_was_built.renderCurve: now returns {X, Y, padL, padT, pw, ph, lMin, lMax, span}; overlays never feed y-span (EQ keeps own +/- scale)

bug_found_and_fixed_during_verification.symptom: target slice drew as 2 stray violet pixels

bug_found_and_fixed_during_verification.fix: alignment window = channel passband; target shift = -(own passband mean), independent of raw measurement level
